name: Settlemany group settlement
description: Pay every creditor of a group in one Bitcoin Cash transaction. Each debtor signs only the coins they spend, and every signature commits to every input and every output.

coordinator.name: Coordinator
coordinator.description: The person who assembles the settlement and names what each creditor is paid.

debtor.name: Debtor
debtor.description: A person who owes the group and signs the coins they spend.

creditor.name: Creditor
creditor.description: A person the group pays. They do not sign this settlement.

settleGroup.name: Settle the group
settleGroup.description: Pay every creditor the exact amount in one transaction.

coordinator.name: Assemble the settlement
coordinator.description: Name the memo and the outputs that pay each creditor.

debtor.name: Sign your coins
debtor.description: Sign only the inputs you own. The signature covers every input and every output.

spendReceivedSettlement.name: Spend what you were paid
spendReceivedSettlement.description: Spend Bitcoin Cash you received from a group settlement.

creditor.name: Spend the payment
creditor.description: Spend coins locked to the settlement receive script.

groupSettlementTransaction.name: Group settled
groupSettlementTransaction.description: Paid every creditor in one transaction.

spendReceivedTransaction.name: Settlement spent
spendReceivedTransaction.description: Spent Bitcoin Cash received from a group settlement.

debtorInput.name: Debtor coin
debtorInput.description: A coin the debtor signs with a signature that commits to the whole settlement.

receivedSettlementInput.name: Received settlement
receivedSettlementInput.description: The payment output a creditor spends after the group settlement.

creditorPayment.name: Creditor payment
creditorPayment.description: The exact amount a creditor is paid.

debtorChange.name: Debtor change
debtorChange.description: Satoshis or tokens returned to the debtor who spent the coin.

settlementMemo.name: Settlement memo
settlementMemo.description: A short note carried in an OP_RETURN output.

onwardPayment.name: Onward payment
onwardPayment.description: Where a creditor sends coins they were paid.

payCreditor.name: Pay a creditor
payCreditor.description: Locks the payment to the creditor address named for this output.

payDebtorChange.name: Return change
payDebtorChange.description: Locks change to the debtor address named for this output.

memoScript.name: Memo
memoScript.description: An unspendable note. The settlement commit supplies the OP_RETURN bytecode.

receivedSettlement.name: Settlement received
receivedSettlement.description: Bitcoin Cash received from a group settlement, spendable by the creditor key.

creditor.name: Creditor
creditor.description: The person who can spend this payment.

dustLimit.name: Dust limit
dustLimit.description: Minimum satoshis for a pay-to-public-key-hash output.

settlementMemo.name: Memo
settlementMemo.description: Short note stored with the settlement.

creditorLockingBytecode.name: Creditor locking bytecode
creditorLockingBytecode.description: Locking bytecode of the creditor who is paid.

debtorLockingBytecode.name: Debtor locking bytecode
debtorLockingBytecode.description: Locking bytecode that receives the debtor's change.

memoLockingBytecode.name: Memo bytecode
memoLockingBytecode.description: OP_RETURN bytecode carrying the settlement note.

debtorKey.name: Debtor key
debtorKey.description: Key that signs the debtor's coins. Paytaca holds this key; the engine does not.

creditorKey.name: Creditor key
creditorKey.description: Key that can spend a payment locked by this template's receive script.

resources.name: Settlemany
resources.description: The group expense app this template was migrated from.
